items.question: Is the first image really free?
items.answer: Yes, completely free. You just need to create an account and you can generate your first image at no cost.

items.question: How much do images cost after the first one?
items.answer: Each additional image costs exactly $1.00 USD. No packages, no subscriptions, just $1 per image you generate.

items.question: How do I make payment?
items.answer: We accept payments through PayPal. It's secure, fast, and reliable. You can pay with your PayPal account or with a credit card through PayPal.

items.question: Do you store my images on your servers?
items.answer: No. Images are generated and downloaded directly to your device. We don't store images on our servers to protect your privacy and save costs.

items.question: How many images can I generate?
items.answer: You can generate as many images as you need. Your first image is free, and each one after costs $1. There are no limits.

items.question: What if I don't like the image the AI generates?
items.answer: We offer a full refund within the first 24 hours if there's any technical problem with your image generation.

items.question: What type of images can I generate?
items.answer: You can create any type of image: realistic portraits, landscapes, abstract art, anime illustrations, professional photography, uncensored +18 content, and much more. No restrictions or limits.

items.question: How long does it take to generate an image?
items.answer: Between 3 and 5 seconds on average. Generation is almost instantaneous and download is immediate.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing and using DreamDuel, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you should not use our service.

sections.heading: 2. Service Description
sections.content: DreamDuel is an image generation service using artificial intelligence. Users pay $1 for each image generated and download it directly. We do not store the generated images on our servers. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue the service at any time.

sections.heading: 3. User Account
sections.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password. You accept responsibility for all activities that occur under your account. You must be at least 13 years old to use this service.

sections.heading: 4. Generated Images and Rights
sections.content: Images generated through our service are downloaded directly by you and are not stored on our servers. You retain all rights to the images you generate and download. You are responsible for the use you make of the generated images and must ensure you do not infringe third-party rights.

sections.heading: 5. Prohibited Conduct
sections.content: You must not use DreamDuel to generate illegal, offensive, harassing, violent, pornographic content, or content that infringes third-party rights. We reserve the right to suspend or cancel accounts that violate these terms. Use of the service must comply with all applicable laws.

sections.heading: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.content: All content, features, and functionality of the service are the exclusive property of DreamDuel and are protected by copyright, trademarks, and other intellectual property laws.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: DreamDuel is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We will not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use the service.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your name and email address. We do not store the images you generate, as they are downloaded directly to your device. We also automatically collect information about your use of the service, including IP address, browser type, and pages visited.

sections.heading: 2. Use of Information
sections.content: We use your information to provide and maintain the image generation service, process payments through PayPal, send you transaction confirmations, improve our service, and protect the platform's security. We do not use the images you generate for any purpose as we do not store them.

sections.heading: 3. Sharing Information
sections.content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information with service providers who help us operate the platform, when required by law, or with your consent.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies and Similar Technologies
sections.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences, understand how you use the service, and improve your experience. You can configure your browser to reject cookies, but this may affect the service's functionality.

sections.heading: 5. Data Security
sections.content: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of Internet transmission is 100% secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, correct, delete, or transfer your personal information. You can also object to the processing of your data or request its limitation. Contact us to exercise these rights.
